Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can get a technical deep dive on the calendar: 

Summary of discovery (short):
- Primary use case: customer support assistant (chat + knowledge retrieval) across web + mobile; ~10k monthly conversations, peak bursts during promotions.
- Key constraints: 95th latency target < 150ms for responses, strict PII handling, data residency in US-east for customer data.
- Integration surface: API-first ingestion, event stream to our system, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Budget/priority: exploring Dedicated/Private for production; prototype can run on hosted.

Immediate next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 45-minute technical deep dive/demo with our Solutions Engineer to walk architecture, model tradeoffs (quantization, batching), and integration patterns.
2) Share a short pre-read (attached) with the prompt examples and high-level architecture so the session can focus on integration decisions.
3) Confirm which people from your side should join (engineering, security, product).

Suggested windows next week (all PST):
- Tue 2026-03-10: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-03-12: 09:30–10:15 or 11:00–11:45

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and I will coordinate. We can do Zoom or Google Meet — you pick.

I've attached a short discovery recap for reference. Lauren (cc) will join as our SE on the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
